label.purpose: Section labels inside panels, in muted-foreground.

eyebrow.purpose: Module name above a page title, uppercase.

numeric.purpose: Numbers that line up: counts, percentages, chapter numbers.

shadows.name: floating

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one main action in a header or panel footer.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 26px; border: 1px solid transparent; font: 500 14px/1 'Public Sans', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--primary, oklch(0.214 0.009 43.1)); color: var(--primary-foreground, oklch(0.986 0.002 67.8)); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary, oklch(0.214 0.009 43.1)) 80%, transparent); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring, oklch(0.714 0.014 41.2)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring, oklch(0.714 0.014 41.2)) 30%, transparent); } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary actions such as Claude setup.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 26px; border: 1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.922 0.005 34.3)); background: var(--background, #fff); color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.147 0.004 49.3)); font: 500 14px/1 'Public Sans', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--muted, oklch(0.96 0.002 17.2)); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring, oklch(0.714 0.014 41.2)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring, oklch(0.714 0.014 41.2)) 30%, transparent); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Filled pill input, no border at rest.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 36px; width: 240px; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 22px; border: 1px solid transparent; background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--input, oklch(0.922 0.005 34.3)) 50%, transparent); color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.147 0.004 49.3)); font: 400 14px 'Public Sans', sans-serif; outline: none; transition: box-shadow 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.547 0.021 43.1)); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--ring, oklch(0.714 0.014 41.2)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring, oklch(0.714 0.014 41.2)) 30%, transparent); }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Topic status as icon, word and soft fill. Never colour alone.
components.html: Learned In progress
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; height: 20px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 22px; font: 500 12px/1 'Public Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-chip-learned { background: var(--topic-learned-soft, oklch(0.955 0.03 152)); color: var(--topic-learned, oklch(0.5 0.12 152)); } .ds-chip-active { background: var(--topic-active-soft, oklch(0.955 0.022 262)); color: var(--topic-active, oklch(0.48 0.14 262)); }

components.name: Panel
components.description: Flat bordered card surface; selected rows take an inset outline.
components.html:
Not started topic
Picked topic
Another topic
components.css: .ds-panel { width: 280px; border-radius: 14px; border: 1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.922 0.005 34.3)); background: var(--card, #fff); color: var(--card-foreground, oklch(0.147 0.004 49.3)); font: 400 14px 'Public Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-row { padding: 10px 14px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.922 0.005 34.3)); } .ds-row:first-child { border-top: 0; border-radius: 14px 14px 0 0; } .ds-row:last-child { border-radius: 0 0 14px 14px; } .ds-row-selected { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--selected, oklch(0.48 0.14 262)); }

components.name: Section Label
components.description: Muted semibold label above a group inside a panel, with a mono count.
components.css: .ds-label { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: baseline; font: 600 12px 'Public Sans', sans-serif; color: var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.547 0.021 43.1)); } .ds-num { font: 400 12px 'Geist Mono', monospace; }

narrative.overview: Loots is one person's bench, not a storefront. The frame is the untouched shadcn Luma default on a warm taupe neutral, kept on purpose as the base to build on, and Loots adds to it one deliberate change at a time. The tools stay quiet and in the same place every visit; colour is spent only where it carries meaning: a topic's status, the item you picked, and which chapter a topic belongs to.
keyCharacteristics: Warm near-black and off-white neutrals (taupe base, hue ~40), no brand accent hue.
Flat bordered panels; shadows only on floating layers.
Pill-shaped controls (Luma preset) against softly rounded panels.
Colour always paired with an icon and a word.
Full light and dark themes, every Loots token defined in both.

rules.name: The Three Families Rule
rules.body: Status, selection and grouping colours never stand in for one another. A chapter colour never means a status; a status colour never decorates.

rules.name: The Icon And Word Rule
rules.body: No colour carries meaning alone. Every status has its own icon shape (filled check, half circle, dashed ring, skip arrow) and its word, in the accessible name too.

rules.name: The Accent Is A Menu Rule
rules.body: In Luma, `accent` is near-black. Never put `bg-accent` on a hover or selected state outside a menu.

rules.name: The Mono For Alignment Rule
rules.body: Mono is for numbers that line up in a column or strip, never for decoration or code-flavoured styling.

rules.name: The Flat Panel Rule
rules.body: An in-page panel is `rounded-xl border bg-card` with no shadow. If something casts a shadow, it floats.

dos: Do build every control from `components/ui`; add a missing one from the registry and use it as shipped.
Do add new colours as role tokens in the Loots section of `globals.css`, with light and dark values and an `@theme inline` entry.
Do check 4.5:1 for text and 3:1 for an outline that is the only cue, in both themes.
Do pair every meaning colour with an icon and a word.
Do keep panels flat and bordered; save shadows for floating layers.
Do write screen copy as names, actions and states, with no em dashes.
donts: Don't edit the shadcn default part of `globals.css` or a primitive in `components/ui` (the only edit is the font line in `sonner.tsx`).
Don't use hex colour classes or old Studio names (`bg-canvas`, `text-quiet`, `shadow-panel`, `font-display`, `status-*`, `tint`); `shadcn-default.test.ts` fails on them.
Don't put `bg-accent` on hover or selected states outside a menu.
Don't use a chapter colour for status, or a status colour for decoration.
Don't add Google Fonts links; fonts load through `next/font`.
Don't align layouts across modules as a sweep; layout differences are module choices.
